title: AdaSTORM: Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration
title_zh: AdaSTORM：通过自适应时空多智能体协作扩展 LLM 在动态图上的推理能力
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable potential in dynamic graph reasoning, but suffer from a scaling bottleneck: current models can only handle graphs with tens of nodes, constrained by exponential reasoning overhead and finite context windows. While multi-agent systems (MAS) offer collective reasoning and topology-aware orchestration, capabilities naturally suited for graph-structured tasks, their application to dynamic graphs remains unexplored. This paper presents Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration (AdaSTORM), a framework that reformulates large-scale dynamic graph reasoning into two stages: (i) Adaptive Partitioning, partitioning large-scale dynamic graphs into subregions that match the model's reasoning capacity while minimizing inference cost; and (ii) Collaborative Reasoning, aligning graph partition topologies with a spatio-temporal decoupled multi-agent architecture. AdaSTORM is the first multi-agent framework tailored for dynamic graph reasoning. Extensive experiments show that AdaSTORM successfully breaks through the scaling bottleneck, scaling reasoning to thousand-node graphs with over 90% accuracy across several large-scale dynamic graph settings without external tools, significantly outperforms seven competitive baselines. Furthermore, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on existing benchmarks and generalizes robustly to real-world datasets. The source code is available at: https://github.com/irisorchid107/AdaSTORM/.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 AdaSTORM，一个面向大规模动态图推理的多智能体框架，旨在突破 Large Language Models 在动态图任务中的规模瓶颈。现有 LLM 通常只能处理几十个节点的图，主要受限于指数级推理开销和有限上下文窗口。AdaSTORM 将动态图推理重构为两个阶段：首先进行 Adaptive Partitioning，将大规模动态图划分为符合模型推理能力、同时尽量降低推理成本的子区域；随后进行 Collaborative Reasoning，将图划分拓扑与时空解耦的多智能体架构对齐，实现协同推理。实验表明，AdaSTORM 能在无需外部工具的情况下将推理扩展到千节点动态图，并在多个大规模动态图设置中取得超过 90% 的准确率，显著优于七个强基线；同时在已有 benchmark 上达到 state-of-the-art，并能稳健泛化到真实世界数据集。
key_points_zh: 首次提出面向动态图推理的多智能体框架 AdaSTORM，利用 MAS 的集体推理与拓扑感知组织能力解决 LLM 图推理扩展难题。
设计 Adaptive Partitioning，将大规模动态图切分为适配 LLM 推理容量的子区域，同时控制推理成本。
设计 Collaborative Reasoning，以时空解耦的多智能体架构对齐图划分拓扑，实现跨子图、跨时间的协同推理。
在多个大规模动态图设置中，AdaSTORM 可扩展到千节点图并保持超过 90% accuracy，无需外部工具。
实验显示其显著优于七个竞争基线，在现有 benchmark 上达到 state-of-the-art，并能泛化到真实世界数据集。

llm_assessment.comment: AdaSTORM is novel for dynamic graph reasoning but has limited relevance to reusable production agent harness infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: AdaSTORM在动态图推理方面有一定新意，但与可复用的生产级智能体运行基础设施关系较弱。
